title: Logic Gate Simulator
description: Interactive AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR and XNOR gates: flip inputs A and B, watch the live output lamp, and see the full truth table with your row highlighted.
howto: Pick a gate: AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR or XNOR.
Toggle inputs A and B (NOT uses A only).
Watch the output lamp and the live Boolean expression update instantly.
Study the full truth table — your current input row is highlighted.

faqs.a: AND: both 1. OR: at least one 1. NOT: inverts. XOR: exactly one 1. NAND/NOR: inverted AND/OR. XNOR: both equal.
NAND (and NOR) are functionally complete: any Boolean function can be built from NAND gates alone, which is why real chips are often NAND-based.

faqs.q: How do I read the truth table?
faqs.a: Each row is one input combination with the gate's output. The row matching your current A/B toggles is highlighted so you can verify the lamp.
